footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Regency Centers: includes $133M from other items, net; after $13.5M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $13.7M of preferred dividends. No per-share figures were reported for these years. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 6.9% to $1.6B in 2025. Operating income rose 7.3% to $1.1B, a 72.3% margin.
Net income rose 32.9% to $514M, or $0.00 per share. Operating cash flow was $828M and free cash flow $828M, versus $790M; Regency Centers returned $512M through dividends.
sources: Regency Centers Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
